verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 96.4 (-3.5% in a day) and momentum is 39: prices are falling. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,500 and 86s 5,500. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-12T07:37:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Tasos Douvikas 86 Star Performer after its 25% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 100,000 coins. Now 106,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 24.8% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 7 of 13 so far, averaging +5.3% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Pedri 91 UEFA Champions League RTTK after its 17% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 2,639,000 coins. Now 2,810,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 17.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.4% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,500 (1.34 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,500 (1.36 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Barbara Bonansea and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Barbara Bonansea 82 Rare -52.9%; Lukas Klostermann 75 Rare -50.0%; Jorge Cuenca 76 Rare -43.4%; Luca Ranieri 75 Rare -34.3%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
